{{Otheruses|Hunter}}
[[File:Twilek_Big-game_Hunter_EtU.png|thumb|right|250px|A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] big-game hunter]]
A '''big game hunter''' or '''big-game hunter''' was a specialization of [[Scout/Legends|explorer]] involving the [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] of large wildlife&mdash;occasionally in uncharted areas or regions. [[Halor Dinnoral]],<ref name="SWMinis">{{WEGCite|story=Big Game (scenario)|book=Imperial Entanglements (Star Wars Miniatures Battles)}}</ref> [[Harno]],<ref name="WotC">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/BP2Harno|series=Bounty Postings|text=2: Harno: Rogue Big Game Hunter}}</ref> [[Moradmin Bast/Legends|Moradmin Bast]],<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=Chief Bast}}</ref> and [[Ozzik Sturn]] were all big-game hunters.<ref name="TFU databank">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'' ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>

Big-game hunters often used [[Stun net/Legends|stun nets]] to capture their trophies; the non-lethal method of trapping the animal left the pelts unmarked.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
